title: SoundService
summary: Controls the audio world: listener setup, ambient reverb, volume rules — plus PlayLocalSound for playing a sound to just the local client.

methods.name: PlayLocalSound
methods.description: Client only. Plays a Sound for this client only, regardless of where the Sound object is parented.

methods.name: SetListener
methods.description: Sets the audio listener (default: the player's camera). ListenerType.Camera or Object with an instance.

properties.name: DistanceFactor / DopplerScale / RolloffIntensity
properties.description: 3D audio tuning: perceived distance scaling, doppler strength, volume falloff intensity.

properties.name: RespectFilteringEnabled
properties.description: Whether client-created sounds are heard only by their creator (default true).

explanation.whatItIs: The audio director: it decides WHERE ears are (the listener), how sound behaves in space (reverb, doppler, falloff), and offers helpers for local playback.
explanation.whyItExists: 3D games need consistent audio physics: footsteps fading with distance, caves echoing, alarms playing for one player privately.
whenToUse: PlayLocalSound for UI clicks and client-only effects
Attaching the listener to a custom camera/object
Tuning doppler/falloff for your game's feel
whenNotToUse: For normal world sounds — parent a Sound to a part and Play() it
explanation.mentalModel:
```text
Sound world model:
  Listener (ears) ←── default: current camera
  Sounds in 3D space ── distance → volume falloff,
                        doppler, reverb (AmbientReverb)

PlayLocalSound = whisper to this client only.
```
tips: UI sounds: create one Sound, keep it around, change SoundId and Play()
For footsteps/impact sync, use Sound.TimePosition and Ended events
Zone reverb: set AmbientReverb when players enter caves/water
commonMistakes: Calling PlayLocalSound from a Script (server) — must be a LocalScript
Creating dozens of Sound instances per play instead of reusing one
Forgetting sounds replicate: a client-created sound isn't heard by others by default

examples.title: Client-only UI sound
examples.code:
-- LocalScript
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

local click = Instance.new("Sound")
click.SoundId = "rbxassetid://12222087"   -- any valid sound id
click.Volume = 0.5

local function playClick()
    SoundService:PlayLocalSound(click)
end

script.Parent.Activated:Connect(playClick)
